subject: E-Commerce
title: TikTok Made Me Buy It
description: Learn TikTok Made Me Buy It in one minute.

hook.text: The hashtag #TikTokMadeMeBuyIt has 80 billion views. Products sell out in hours after going viral on the app.

buildup.text: TikTok's algorithm shows products to millions of people who never searched for them. Pure discovery commerce.

discovery.text: A viral video of the Stanley tumbler turned a $40 cup into a cultural phenomenon. Sales jumped 275% in one year.

twist.text: Most TikTok-viral products are impulse buys under $30. The platform excels at cheap, novelty purchases.

climax.text: TikTok proved that entertainment drives commerce better than search. Fun sells more than features.

punchline.text: 80B views, sold-out Stanley cups. TikTok turned impulse buying into culture.

quiz.question: What price range do most TikTok-viral products fall into?
